title: Introduce RAG Navigator: lightweight interactive playground and CLI walkthrough
author: Priya Natarajan
release_notes: Add a compact interactive RAG playground called 'RAG Navigator' with a minimal CLI, browser devserver, and opinionated telemetry probes for quick local experimentation; targeted at developer onboarding and internal workshops.
description: Context and motivation: teams keep asking for a tiny, batteries-included RAG playground that lets new engineers run a retrieval+agent loop locally with minimal setup and observable telemetry. This PR adds 'RAG Navigator', a lightweight quickstart that combines: 1) a minimal Node-based CLI to scaffold an index and seed prompts; 2) a small devserver that serves a compact interactive UI for stepwise inspection of agent decisions and tool calls; 3) opinionated telemetry probes that emit structured traces (local file/console) for step-level assertions; 4) example prompt templates and a guided walkthrough README. Checklist: - [x] scaffold CLI and devserver - [x] add telemetry probes and sample assertions - [x] provide two example corpora (kb-small, kb-news) - [x] include CI smoke tests and offline index fixture - [x] add docs quickstart page and links to examples gallery Implementation notes: the CLI is intentionally minimal (no auth required) and targets local-first experimentation; it supports `nav init`, `nav index --corpus=kb-small`, `nav run --scenario=tutor`, and `nav export-session`. The devserver runs on :5173, serves a compact single-page authoring UI with stepwise trace view and a tool-call inspector. Telemetry format is newline-delimited JSON to simplify ingestion by local eval harnesses. Security: playground is explicitly for dev use; README warns about not exposing to public networks. Related work: follows conventions from the authoring-studio and step-replayer projects but is intentionally compact for workshops (see ENG-4821). Testing: added a CI job that runs `nav index` against a bundled offline fixture and executes a headless smoke-run that asserts the agent reaches an expected final step. Migration and rollout: non-destructive; added under examples with its own README and docsite quickstart. Links: linear/ENG-4821, support ticket SUP-7789.
